title.zh: 谷歌前CEO施密特持有Anthropic约1%股份，IPO有望带来巨额财富增值
title.en: 谷歌前CEO施密特持有Anthropic约1%股份，IPO有望带来巨额财富增值

current_state.zh: Bloomberg reports that former Google CEO Eric Schmidt holds roughly 1% of Anthropic from a 2021 Series A investment of tens of millions at a $461M valuation — a stake worth close to $10B at the company's recent $965B valuation — as Anthropic prepares to start IPO marketing as early as the week of November 9 with trading targeted before year-end.
